text:
maria: FYI customer acme-onboard reported large spike of 5xx/gateway timeouts during onboarding burst, started ~09:12 UTC. ~30% of requests were 504/502. They provided a trace id: trace-9f3b. sample error: "upstream read timeout after 30s".

maria: curl they used: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"input":"long sequence..."}'` — they said retries just amplified the backlog.

jake: opened SEV ticket with account ops. Customer also saw intermittent 401s a few minutes before the 5xx spike, billing said quota refresh failed at 09:10 UTC but then recovered. unsubtle correlation but not sure causation.

sre-bot: autoscaler event: [09:11:56] ScaledObject "svc-acme-infer" no activity: minReplicaCount=0, cooldown=2m. [09:12:18] KEDA scaler: detected queue surge -> target 10 replicas. Creating scale request. [09:12:18] HPA: scale up requested -> newReplicas=10; observedDelay=33s; readiness probe timeout on new pods.

alena: digging into cluster events — readiness probe on model pods failing during init. logs show model-init taking ~38s and liveness/readiness probe set to 30s. KEDA/HPA are requesting pods but readiness deadlines cause them to be considered unready and HPA doesn't reach desired. config mismatch.

devon: yup that matches. Also saw scaledobject annotations that disable prewarm: `redwood.dev/prewarm: "false"` on this tenant. Prewarm would have kept a warm pod pool and avoided cold stalls. Looks like onboarding template accidentally disabled it.

maria: customer onboarding template is the default for new tenants — we pushed a change last week to reduce idle cost and defaulted prewarm=false. bad timing.

ops: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) bump minReplicas to 2 for svc-acme-infer, 2) temporarily increase readinessTimeout to 60s, 3) re-enable prewarm annotation for this tenant. Anyone object?

devon: +1 to all. Also push a short-term fallback: route requests to `model-small-v1` for this tenant while we stabilize to avoid large init times. Add a model variant fallback in routing policy.

jake: informing customer of mitigation now and asking for repro window. letting them know we rotated their onboarding flow to fallback small model and increased minReplicas.

alena: repro steps we used: run `wrk -t10 -c100 -d60s -s ./scripts/payload_long.lua https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` with payload seq_len 1024 to simulate. Observed queue length > 120 at peak and many requests hit gateway timeout 30s.

maria: logs snippet from gateway at peak: ```
[09:12:45] proxy gateway request id=trace-9f3b upstream_timeout after 30s connecting to 10.42.7.23:8080
[09:12:46] auth: token validated but billingquota check delayed: refresh timeout 5s
```

sre-bot: note: billing check timeouts can backpressure request handling. If auth/billing call blocks the frontend for >5s under concurrency, proxies will queue and exacerbate coldstart.

alena: root cause summary: onboarding defaulted prewarm=false -> no warm pool; KEDA/HPA requested scale but new pods' readiness probe timeout < model init time -> pods marked unready then evicted/backoff; concurrent billing/auth check latencies amplified gateway queuing -> 504s.

ops: actions: (P0) re-enable prewarm for onboarding tenants, (P0) set minReplicas=2 for acme, (P1) increase readiness timeout to 60s for model runtime, (P1) add a short-circuit for billing check under high load (cache token status 1s).

devon: I will apply minReplicas and readiness update to the k8s manifest for svc-acme-infer now. alena please run verify.

alena: applying changes and restarting scaledobject to pick up annotation. running smoke: `wrk -t8 -c40 -d20s` — initial verification shows 0% 5xx after changes.

jake: customer update: they confirmed latency back to expected and accepted fallback to smaller model for first 24h while we monitor. They asked for postmortem and billing credit.

maria: creating postmortem and billing credit request. Will include repro steps, config diff, and recommended platform defaults (prewarm=true for onboarding, readiness default 45s).

ops: follow-up: add automated check in onboarding pipeline to assert `redwood.dev/prewarm` not false, and add alert when scaledobject minReplicaCount==0 for production tenants.

maria: thanks all. I'll link the ticket and postmortem here when done. :white_check_mark:
